title: Essential network
paper_reference: Legacy demo v2 run: below Table 2's budget range (20 kEUR) and at operational ratio 0.025 instead of the Table D.8 baseline 0.05; superseded by budget_060k
audience_pitch: The city invests the minimum. Where do the few stations go, and who is left out?
narrative: With a small budget the optimiser must triage: it concentrates stations where demand and public-transport connections pay off most, and whole neighbourhoods stay uncovered. The simulation shows riders finding no station nearby, and stations running empty at the morning peak.

expected_story.service: lowest coverage and served ratio of the three scenarios
expected_story.economics: smallest investment; best served-trips-per-euro -- the first euros are the most productive
